deals.title: Red Lentil Dal
deals.description:
Ingredients
• 1 cup Farm Boy™ Red Lentils, rinsed
• 1 pack (900 mL) Farm Boy™ Organic Low Sodium Vegetable Broth
• 1 Tbsp Farm Boy™ Virgin Cold Pressed Sunflower Oil or butter
• 1 ½ cups diced onion
• 3 garlic cloves, minced
• 1 Tbsp minced ginger
• 2 long green hot chilies, minced (seeded if you want less heat), plus more for garnish
• ½ Tbsp Farm Boy™ Organic Mild Curry Powder
• 1 tsp black mustard seeds, optional
• ½ tsp Farm Boy™ Organic Ground Coriander
• ¼ tsp Farm Boy™ Organic Ground Cumin
• ½ tsp salt, or to taste
• 1 ½ cups chopped Roma tomatoes
• Cilantro leaves for garnish
• Cooked basmati rice, for serving
• Farm Boy™ Whole Wheat Naan, for serving

Directions
1. In a large saucepan, place Farm Boy™ Red Lentils and Farm Boy™ Organic Low Sodium Vegetable Broth. Bring to a boil, then turn down to simmer. Remove any foam that rises to the top as it simmers. Cook, partially covered, until lentils are tender, about 15-18 minutes.
2. While lentils cook, heat Farm Boy™ Virgin Cold Pressed Sunflower Oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat. Add onion, garlic, ginger, and chilis and cook, stirring often, until softened, about 5 minutes.
